exploit_name: Credits not accumulated across legs in multi-leg collateral calculation
description: The credits variable is overwritten per iteration instead of accumulated across legs. Only the last qualifying leg's credit is preserved.
root_cause: The credits variable is overwritten per iteration instead of accumulated across legs. Only the last qualifying leg's credit is preserved.
fix_description: Treat credits as an accumulator: credits += ... instead of overwriting each iteration.
notes: Account undercounts margin, incorrectly classifying solvent accounts as insolvent, triggering unjustified liquidations.
